title: 第4935章 叶炎要做什么要与帝主一战吗第4934章 与你百帝山不死不休又如何
content_zh:
轰隆！
此时，天地震颤，要湮灭一切一般。
在所有人目光之下，顿时间看到百帝山这些存在的四周，一切都碎裂开来。
甚至，那虚空也碎裂到了尽头。
“嘶！”
仅此一眼，便让人骇然到了极致。
“这气息？”
“竟如此强大？”
“这便是神尊符文吗？”
“仅仅是一道符文，竟是如此？”
“神尊与天帝比，我不清楚如何，毕竟，到了现在，我已难以感受这符文到底强大到了何等层次，但，绝对比大帝强大。”
这一瞬，很多老辈修炼者开口。
对此，不少人也随之点了点头。
神尊，绝对强过大帝。
而在众人这般叹然之下，这神尊符文上的光华，也是分成两道，其中一道向着帝兽古山而去。
另外一道，则是狠狠的向着叶炎袭来。
“这？”
嘶！
咕咚！
“叶炎，完了！”在吞咽了一口唾液之后，不少的修炼者唏嘘一叹，在他们看来，这等一力之下，叶炎必定湮灭。

就算是刚才的那等树叶，也绝对无法挡住吧？
此等之力，太恢弘。
关键是，这乃是百帝山这诸位强者联手催动。
根本无法撄锋。
嘭！
一时间，在所有人唏嘘之下，这其中一道神尊符文之力已然与帝兽古山触碰在了一起，刹那间一道沉闷的声音便是响彻在了这片区域之内。
噗通！
原本在那神尊符文催动的一瞬，已有诸多修炼者匍匐跪下，而如今在这轰鸣声下，就算是一些来自帝族、帝宗等修炼者也难以支撑，匍匐在了地面之上。
这一幕，让人愈发震叹。
轰！
而如此下，另外一道神尊符文之力，已然来到了叶炎面前，随后那声音也震动了十方。
“这？”
“那一道力量，已落在了叶炎的身上了吧？”
“如此之下，叶炎怕已……”
此刻，诸多修炼者感慨道。
“哈哈哈！”
content_en:
Boom!
At this time, the heaven and earth trembled, as if they were annihilating everything.
Under everyone's gaze, everything around these beings in Baidi Mountain suddenly fell into pieces.
Even the void was shattered to the end.
"Hiss!"
Just this one look made people horrified to the extreme.
"This breath?"
"So powerful?"
"Is this the divine rune?"
"It's just a rune, but it's like this?"
"I don't know how the Divine Lord compares to the Emperor of Heaven. After all, up to now, I can no longer feel how powerful this rune is, but it is definitely stronger than the Emperor."
At this moment, many older cultivators spoke.
In response, many people nodded.
The god is definitely stronger than the emperor.
While everyone was sighing, the brilliance on the divine rune also split into two paths, one of which headed towards the Ancient Mountain of Emperor Beast.
The other one attacked Ye Yan fiercely.
"This?"
Hiss!
Gudong!
"Ye Yan, it's over!" After swallowing a mouthful of saliva, many cultivators sighed. In their opinion, Ye Yan would definitely be annihilated under such a force.
Even those leaves just now can't stop it, right?
This kind of power is too magnificent.
The key is that this is the joint effort of the powerful people from Baidi Mountain.
There's no way to start a fight.
Bang!
For a moment, everyone was sighing, and the power of one of the divine runes was already in contact with the ancient mountain of the emperor beast. In an instant, a dull sound resounded throughout the area.
Plop!
Originally, many cultivators had knelt down when the divine rune was activated, but now under the roar, even some cultivators from the Imperial Clan, Emperor Sect, etc. could not support themselves and prostrated themselves on the ground.
This scene made people even more shocked.
boom!
And like this, another divine rune power came to Ye Yan, and then the sound shook the world.
"This?"
"That force has fallen on Ye Yan, right?"
"Under this situation, Ye Yan is afraid..."
At this moment, many practitioners sighed with emotion.
"Hahaha!"
